tasks.description: Implement DungeonBridge.ts — all 4 stubbed functions. This module is the boundary between GameState and external consumers. getVisibleEntities(state, agentId): use rot.js FOV (ROT.FOV.PreciseShadowcasting) with radius from game-config (import fov_radius=6). Compute visible tiles for the agent, then collect VisibleEntity objects for all enemies, items, other agents, boss entrances, bosses, and chests within visible tiles. Each VisibleEntity includes distance (Manhattan). toAgentPayload(state, agentId): build AgentStatePayload with the agent's own state + visibleEntities from getVisibleEntities + formatted recentPatches. toDashboardPayload(state): build DashboardPayload with full tiles array, all agents, enemies, bossInstances, groundItems, recentPatches, arenaMatchups, finalScores, dungeonTimer. formatPatchesForAgent(state): map state.recentPatches to human-readable strings like 'stamina.heavy_attack_cost changed from 30 to 25: reduce aggression dominance'. Import ROT from 'rot-js'. This is a pure data transformation module — no side effects, no I/O.

tasks.description: Implement EnemyAI.ts — resolveEnemyActions, resolveOneEnemy, findNearestAgent, pathfindStep, and resetEnemyAIState. This is rule-based only — zero Claude API calls. CRITICAL: PITFALL 2 — module-level Maps/Sets (bruteTurnCounters, sentinelTurnCounters, sentinelHasSummoned) must be wrapped in resetEnemyAIState() which is called at game start. Per-tier behavior: Grunt — pathfind toward nearest agent (A* via rot.js ROT.Path.AStar), attack if isAdjacent, damage = config.enemies.grunt_damage. Brute — move toward nearest agent, on odd turns telegraph 'heavy_strike' (set telegraphedAction on EnemyState), on even turns execute if adjacent to target. Sentinel — counts turns; every 3rd turn: block (reduce incoming damage 50%); at or below 30% HP: summon one grunt on nearest empty tile (once only). Hex Caster — maintain distance 3-4 from nearest agent; if too close, pathfind away; if at range, hex attack (bypasses armor). Shade — if on unexplored tile and first strike: 50% miss chance; otherwise attack nearest agent. findNearestAgent: returns closest living agent. pathfindStep: use ROT.Path.AStar to compute next tile toward target, return single step. Import EnemyAction with newPosition for moves. Use Manhattan distance for isAdjacent. All functions use immutable patterns on state.
tasks.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. resolveEnemyActions iterates all alive enemies and returns EnemyAction[] with one action per enemy. Grunt moves toward nearest agent when not adjacent, attacks when adjacent. Brute alternates telegraph/attack. Sentinel blocks on turn 3,6,9... and summons grunt once at ≤30% HP. Hex Caster maintains range 3-4, attacks from range. Shade has first-strike miss chance only from unexplored tiles. findNearestAgent returns closest living agent by Manhattan distance. pathfindStep returns adjacent position toward target using A*. resetEnemyAIState clears all internal counters — safe for multiple game runs in same process. EnemyAction includes newPosition for move actions. No Claude API calls anywhere in this module.

tasks.description: Implement StateEmitter.ts — broadcast, logEvent, broadcastPatch, and sendSnapshot. CRITICAL: PITFALL 1 — wsClients is an in-process Set populated by server.ts WebSocket connection handler. broadcast must work within the same Node.js process. broadcast(state): convert state to DashboardPayload via DungeonBridge.toDashboardPayload, JSON.stringify, send to every WebSocket in wsClients whose readyState is OPEN. Wrap in try-catch per client — one dead connection must not kill the loop. logEvent(event): append one NDJSON line to state/game-events.jsonl using fs.appendFileSync (safe for single-process synchronous game loop). Include event type, round, phase, timestamp, and data. broadcastPatch(patch): construct PatchEvent { type: 'PATCH_APPLIED', key, oldValue, newValue, reason, timestamp }, call logEvent, then broadcast to all clients. sendSnapshot(ws, state): send current DashboardPayload to a single newly-connected WebSocket client. Import DungeonBridge.toDashboardPayload. Path to game-events.jsonl must resolve relative to project root (use path.resolve + fileURLToPath for ESM).
tasks.acceptance: npm run build exits 0. broadcast sends JSON DashboardPayload to all connected WebSocket clients. logEvent appends valid NDJSON line to state/game-events.jsonl — verify with: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('state/game-events.jsonl','utf8').trim().split('\n').pop())". broadcastPatch logs a PATCH_APPLIED event and broadcasts state update. sendSnapshot sends current state to a single new client. Dead client connections do not crash broadcast (try-catch per client). No duplicate event writes. All functions handle empty wsClients Set gracefully.
